mapper.select: SELECT order_id, order_no, customer_id, order_dt, ship_to, shipping_method, status_cd, amount, reg_id, reg_dt, update_id, update_dt FROM ecm_order WHERE order_no = #{orderNo}
SELECT order_id, order_no, customer_id, order_dt, ship_to, shipping_method, status_cd, amount, reg_id, reg_dt, update_id, update_dt FROM ecm_order WHERE order_id = #{orderId}

SELECT o.order_id, o.order_no, c.customer_nm, c.email AS customer_email, o.order_dt, o.ship_to, o.status_cd, o.amount FROM ecm_order o INNER JOIN ecm_customer c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
AND o.status_cd = #{statusCd}
AND ( o.order_no ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.customer_nm ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.email ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR o.ship_to ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY o.order_dt DESC, o.order_id DESC LIMIT 500
